title.narrative: Ensuring Access to Essential Primary Health Care to Vulnerable Communities in Jordan Valley and East Jerusalem through Provision of Mobile Clinic Services

description.narrative: ltpgtThe project will provide mobile clinic services tonbspat least 4,450 people (directly 3,413 and indirectly 1137)nbspliving in 7 underserved Bedouin communities in Jordan Valley (Marj Ghazal, Fasayil Al Fuqa, Al Murajat East, Jiftlik Ash Shuneh, Jiftlik Abu Ajaj, Jiftlik Al Musafah and Jiftlik Al Muthalth)nbspdue to isolation and increasing settler attacks these communities have many health issuesnbspincluding lack of hygiene, and lack of access to resources and healthcare facilities and they face challenges in accessing healthcare elsewhere. The mobile clinic team will include a GP, a women’s health doctor, a lab technician, two community health workers, a MHPSS specialist and a driver. Aligned with the Mobile Clinic Working Group recommendations, the mobile clinic will provide a package of PHC services including general practice care, child healthcare, women's health care, ante natal care,nbspsexual and reproductive health, health awareness and mental health and psycho social support (MHPSS). The clinic team will providenbspscreening and basic lab test andnbsphome visits when needed to ensure health services reach the most vulnerable. Due to increasing access issues, the clinic team will provide first aid training to community members, including psychological first aid and hygiene information and kits. The mobile clinic will visit each community weekly according to Mobile Clinic Working Group standards. MAP has experience in working with partners to deliver mobile clinic projects. This project will be directly implemented to support providing a full package of health services to the communities. This project builds on MAP's ten years experience in supporting mobile clinic service delivery in Area C communities as well as over 20 years operating in the West Bank to support Palestinian's access health care.nbspltbrgtlt/pgt
